name: skill-vault-assistant
description: The Skill Vault app's built-in AI assistant: the vault-assistant lead agent, five skill-backed specialist subagents (repo-hunter, update-fixer, skill-scout, error-triager, notion-doctor), and ten skills covering vault operations, the vault format, GitHub sync, origin hunting, Notion sync, error triage, suggestion analysis, app navigation, skill authoring, and GitHub skill discovery.
